_comment: S188 THE SWARM — the bat swarm (vampires level 10). Built by scripts/build-scattered-sheet-atlas.mjs.
SHEETS CHOSEN (every sheet in this folder was measured S188 before choosing — see FINDINGS.md + the branch report):
· FLY = sheet-fly.png (8x3), NOT the 6x4 re-roll. sheet-fly-matted.png was matted by border flood-fill, which keeps
ENCLOSED white: 12,611 opaque near-white px, largest pocket 137 px, 6,417 px of it on the cut edge — white blotches
on the black board and a check:atlas FAIL (pocket max 60, edge max 60). A colour-to-alpha re-matte of raw-fly-v2
fixed the white but ghosted the swarm on black, and the re-roll is a crisper cel style than attack/die. sheet-fly
is the SAME soft-glow drawing as the attack and die sheets (largest white pocket 15, 0 on the edge).
· ATTACK = sheet-attack.png (6x4), the only one. scaleMul 0.8: it was generated at a larger zoom than the fly and die
sheets — measured on the red eye glow, whose size does not change with pose: 27x31 px (attack) vs 20x26 (fly) and
~21x24 (die frames 1-4), ratio ~0.79. Without it the attack row reads 1.28x WIDER than the idle/walk rows.
· DIE = sheet-die-v2.png (6x4). sheet-die-v1.png is REJECTED: 0.0% transparent (opaque magenta wash, grey grid baked in,
and a 5x5 grid). v2 has a 2 px grey grid baked in too (x = 256k, y = 255 + 256k, alpha ~39/20) — inpainted below.
FRAMES: idle/walk = every other fly frame (1..23; the cycle V -> level -> wrapped -> V closes 23 -> 1).
attack = every other frame 1..23: pick 7 (sheet frame 13) is the first X-slash frame, at tick 30 = GOBLIN_ATTACK_FIRE_TICK
at 5 ticks/frame — the slash appears as the damage lands. die = every other frame 2..24, ending on the fully dispersed one.
SIZE: the fly frames' median body height is fitted to 125 px in a 200 px cell — the SHIPPED bat's measured body height
(check-atlas-scenery's own measure) — so BAT_SWARM_SPRITE_SCALE_MUL (2, MINE) is exactly the swarm:bat size ratio.
ticksPerFrame = the shipped bat's (idle 7 / walk 4 / attack 5 / die 5).
